_comment: Source of truth for OWASP Agentic CWE/CVE/severity mapping used by AI-Agent-tests/generated_tests/*.yml. Resolution order is by_template > by_family (longest-prefix match) > unexpected_code_execution > by_category. Each layer overrides individual fields (category, cwe, cve, severity). Severity is impact-based (HIGH=direct compromise or concrete security boundary breach, MEDIUM=policy/business/quality breach with limited blast radius, LOW=quality only).
